description: This plot illustrates the Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output at a threshold of 1e-2 across different layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and employs a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with numeric tick marks positioned at intervals of 0.2. The line representing "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03" is depicted as a blue dashed line without markers. It begins at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.18 at layer 0, declines sharply to about 0.04 by layer 2, and maintains a relatively steady, low trend throughout the rest of the plot, ending near 0.00 at layer 23. The "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44" is shown as an orange dotted line without markers. It starts high at approximately 0.98 at layer 0, follows a downward trend to about 0.29 at layer 10, experiences fluctuations between approximately 0.18 and 0.28 from layers 13 to 20, exhibits a noticeable peak of roughly 0.40 at layer 21, and concludes at approximately 0.38 at layer 23. The "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33" is represented by a green dash-dot line with no markers. This line originates at a value of 1.00 at layer 0, shows a steep decline to roughly 0.36 at layer 7 and 0.19 at layer 10, and then gradually decreases with minor fluctuations, such as peaks of 0.13 at layer 14 and 0.11 at layer 21, before ending at approximately 0.04 at layer 23.
